source: Home page copy. Written for the site during the design build, not Gina's words, unless a field says otherwise; the founder lines restate her About copy. Moved out of index.astro on 25 October 2026 so it can be edited in the CMS (docs/POLISH-PLAN.md, B15). The journeys cards and the journal introduction follow the client's brief of 25 October 2026 (docs/WORK-PLAN.md, changes 4 and 5); the journal introduction makes no promise about how often it is updated (Q7).

hero.lede: Thoughtful journeys, rare experiences and every detail looked after by people who know travel, and take the time to know you.

intro.heading: Travel has changed. Good service shouldn't.
intro.lead: Personal, professional advice is still the best way to see the world.
intro.detail: From a quick escape to a three-month journey, Travelling Places brings together more than 100 years of collective industry experience to get the details right.

journeys.heading: Journeys shaped around you.
journeys.intro: Every traveller is different. We bring first-hand knowledge and careful judgement to the way you want to explore.

cards.label: Cruising
cards.hrefNote: Interim link to the cruising section of Tailor-made. The owner is supplying the destination (register C23).

virtuoso.heading: More doors open with the right connections.
virtuoso.body: Our Virtuoso membership connects you with leading hotels, cruise lines, destination specialists and tour partners around the world.

founder.heading: A travel company built on curiosity and care.
founder.lead: Gina brought her industry experience from New Zealand and London to Tamborine Mountain and founded Travelling Places in 1993.
founder.body: More than three decades later, the company still works the way she intended: listen carefully, share honest advice and look after every detail.
founder.quote: Our focus is on you, ensuring we offer the very best arrangements to fulfil your travel dreams.

journal.heading: Journal
journal.intro: Stories, practical advice and first-hand discoveries from Gina and the team.
